Maya (CS): Heads up — Meridian EBR is scheduled for next Wed. Need a quick slide stitch: 10m exec readout + 15m ops deep-dive. Can we confirm owners, renewal signal, and any hard asks? @Kevin C-S @Samir Patel @Lina Gomez
Kevin C-S: I can own the exec readout (10m). Will highlight renewal signal + cost impact.
Samir Patel: I'll take the onboarding/status slide — need latest migration date, active seats, and any open escalations from Jordan.
Lina Gomez: I'll own enablement & adoption metrics. @Omar Khan can you paste NPS and the adoption chart?
Omar Khan: NPS = 7.8 last qtr. Pasting chart to #customer-docs and uploading CSV now.
Maya (CS): Great. Quick constraints: 1) slide owners finalized by EOD Tue, 2) risk tier callouts must be inline on slides (green/yellow/red), 3) each slide needs a one-line backup talking point for execs.
Kevin C-S: Added backup talking points to speaker notes. Example:
```
Slide 3 owner: Samir Patel
Talking point: Migration completed; p95 latency down 22%; ask: agree post-cutover runbook and support window
```
Lina Gomez: Renewal signal looks YELLOW — usage dip on embeddings and a recent billing spike. Proposed ask: schedule Optimize audit + monthly usage review with AM.
Samir Patel: AM (Jordan) is looping infra for a cost breakdown. I'll add Jordan as reviewer on the slide and call out pending items.
Maya (CS): Action list (please ack with ETA): - Kevin C-S: final exec notes + slide order (Tue EOD) - Samir Patel: onboarding metrics + confirm AM responses (Tue noon) - Lina Gomez: enablement metrics + recommendation (Tue EOD) - Omar Khan: NPS chart + raw data link (Mon)
ebr-bot: Reminder: EBR template v3 deployed. https://internal/docs/ebr-template
Kevin C-S: Scheduling a dry run Thu 10am. Can everyone make that?
Maya (CS): please +1 if you can.
Samir Patel: +1
Lina Gomez: +1
Omar Khan: +1
Kevin C-S: I'll assemble a one-slide risk ladder (green/yellow/red) and a fallback script for exec questions.
Maya (CS): Perfect — I'll consolidate slides after the dry run and send final deck to execs Fri AM. Thanks all :pray:
